Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can attack your opponent.
Card Q&A.q: Can this Digimon attack my opponent when I don't have a Digimon with [Myotismon] in its name in play?

Card Q&A.a: This card’s [Your Turn] effect only prevents you from declaring an opponent's Digimon as the target of the attack. If this Digimon is blocked, conduct the battle between the two Digimon as normal.
Card Q&A.q: I attack my opponent with this Digimon while I don't have a Digimon with [Myotismon] in its name in play, and it’s blocked by an opponent’s Digimon. What happens?

Effect: ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.)
[Your Turn] While you don't have a Digimon with [Myotismon] in its name in play, this Digimon can't attack your opponent's Digimon.
